tools.name: calendars.list
tools.description: List every configured Calendar with independent Event and To-do capability evidence.

tools.name: calendar_entities.query
tools.description: Query persisted Event or To-do resource snapshots within an explicit Calendar Scope.

tools.name: calendar_occurrences.query
tools.description: Query bounded derived occurrences over a half-open UTC range.

tools.name: calendar_resources.get
tools.description: Read one semantic Calendar Object Resource by an explicitly confirmed absolute href.

tools.description: Create one typed Event in the default or explicitly selected Calendar.

tools.name: events.patch
tools.description: Apply a revision-bound semantic patch to one Event resource.

tools.name: todos.create
tools.description: Create one typed To-do in the default or explicitly selected Calendar.

tools.name: todos.patch
tools.description: Apply a revision-bound semantic patch to one To-do resource.

tools.name: todos.complete
tools.description: Record completion for one revision-bound To-do or identified To-do occurrence.

tools.name: calendar_occurrences.add
tools.description: Add one explicit recurrence identity through recurrence data.

tools.description: Add one explicit exclusion to a revision-bound recurrence set.

tools.description: Remove only one explicit recurrence exclusion.

tools.description: Create or update one cancelled recurrence override.

tools.description: Read one confirmed absolute href through a protected MCP resource link.

tools.description: Create an exact UTF-8 resource at an explicit destination resource href.

tools.description: Confirm and replace one revision-bound resource with exact UTF-8 content.
